status: prepared only; no compile, runtime, equivalence or performance claim yet
stagnation_proof: Validated latitude endpoints are finite and 32 <= lower <= upper <= 40, so NaN, infinity and signed zero are unreachable. Rust to_bits equality and JavaScript numeric equality therefore express the same stagnation condition.

Let m be the unchanged existing expression lower + (upper - lower) * 0.5. If m equals lower or upper, either comparison branch leaves the interval unchanged or collapses it to [m,m]. In both states every later midpoint and the final midpoint is exactly m.

Skipping Q(m) and later fixed-point iterations does not change longitude, the computed target, errors from input/bounds checks, final strict-interior checks, returned bits or supplemental draw behavior. No error-producing operation is skipped inside Q.
The exact value where the break occurs and saved Q call count remain to be measured; the extra per-step branch may offset saved work.
horner_proof: The original recurrence starts p=9/17 and assigns p=c+z*p for c=8/15,7/13,6/11,5/9,4/7,3/5,2/3,1. The nested expression has this identical multiplication/addition tree and all original division expressions.
No reassociation, FMA, coefficient rounding replacement, precomputation, changed termination or changed source data is introduced.
The target is avoiding per-call coefficient-array and for-of work. Actual allocations may already be optimized away by the engine, so no speed or memory reduction is yet claimed.
past_work: perf2-math had one constants-only smoke and unexecuted Rust prefix/unroll drafts. No stagnation or JavaScript nested-Horner qualification was performed. Constants-only metadata is deferred because it adds persistent state for just two Q calls per candidate.
